subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What TLS identity policy should iOS Remote Domain mode use for public reverse-proxy and anycast hostnames that legitimately serve multiple leaf certificates?
rationale: The current single-leaf pin is incompatible with the reported topology, but automatically accepting every device-trusted replacement changes the anti-impersonation guarantee established by the iOS security stack.

options.title: Add explicit trust modes
options.body: Keep strict pinning as the default and let users explicitly select system-PKI hostname validation for public reverse-proxy or anycast domains.

options.title: Allow multiple leaf pins
options.body: Persist a bounded set of explicitly approved fingerprints per gateway, preserving pinning but potentially requiring repeated prompts as edge certificates change.

options.title: Use system PKI for Remote Domain
options.body: Make all Remote Domain connections rely on device CA trust and hostname validation, simplifying Cloudflare use while intentionally removing the extra leaf-pin boundary.

recommendation.title: Add explicit trust modes
recommendation.body: Keep strict pinning as the default and let users explicitly select system-PKI hostname validation for public reverse-proxy or anycast domains.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant security contract appears to originate in security hardening commits they carried, making them the strongest available owner for the trust-boundary choice.
